people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul said, “Bring the burnt offering to me here, and the peace offerings.” He offered the burnt offering.
translations.bsb: So he said, “Bring me the burnt offering and the peace offerings.” And he offered up the burnt offering.
translations.kjv: And Saul said, Bring hither a burnt offering to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.
translations.asv: And Saul said, Bring hither the burnt-offering to me, and the peace-offerings. And he offered the burnt-offering.
